name: AI assistant
author: Brett
description: The console's AI assistant is Gizmo (Nov 10 2026: the old assistant chat is gone, Gizmo's chat moved here from AmberX). A Claude-style chat on the framework's assistant engine (assistant@1): chats drawer with search and pins, streaming replies that survive a reload, markdown and code, tool cards, write-mode approval cards, images and files, edit and resend, regenerate, read aloud, export; per chat an agent picker (Gizmo or any agent trained in the agents section) and a model switch (Claude Opus / Fable, or a local Ollama model); voice chat (push to talk, hands-free) in the browser; console control tools (open screens and settings, run actions, file builds). Every provider in the shared registry, setup wizard in Settings → Plugins → AI assistant. AmberX's Gizmo uses the same engine and chats. Hub users chat at /api/plugins/ai-assistant/app.

builtWith.rebuildOf: Opus build of Oct 18 2026 (pending item ai-assistant-plugin)
